Found a workaround - make a new material with Terrain/Nature/Standard shader and assign this material to Base Terrain Material in terrain settings. This will also make fog working with Terrain.
Screenshot from vrchat with working lightmapping.

3 terrain ones: 
Nature/Terrain/Diffuse 
Nature/Terrain/Specular 
Nature/Terrain/Standard
Should be fixed by including terrain shaders and making sure lightmode variants aren't stripped during building via this setting:

details:
Unity terrain not affected by lightmaps in VRChat. In Unity editor terrain looks correct but in VRChat lightmaps on terrain are missing.

Made a test world: terrain and cubes are static, directional light mode set to Mixed. Point lights mode set to Baked. Lighting mode set to Shadowmask. Realtime GI disabled.

Test world ID: wrld_a68baa2d-5877-4343-b2a3-2122e8342702
title: Terrain not affected by lightmapping
